metadata.description: UNOFFICIAL community fork of linxule/kimi-plugin-cc, maintained by BRILIA, developed and verified on Windows 11, and running on macOS and Linux as well. Upstream does not support Windows. On Windows, hook paths are normalised so setup works without a manual override, the safety hook command is double-quoted so cmd.exe can launch it (the single-quoted form cannot run there, so the write guard would be silently off), and the shell probe runs instead of reporting success without running. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Moonshot AI or the upstream author.
